162.question: The evolutionary character of social change is determined by...

options.A: the abrupt destruction of the social system in the course of class conflict
options.B: random fluctuations of values without any general direction
options.C: a return of society to the original state of traditional ways of life
options.D: the gradual, orderly growth in the complexity of society from simple forms to complex ones
options.E: an instant replacement of the ruling group without any change in the structure itself

163.question: A technological innovation becomes an object of sociological analysis when what is studied is...

options.A: its influence on social relations, employment and the structure of society
options.B: the design of the device, its schematic diagram and the physical principle of its operation
options.C: the cost of materials, the patenting procedure and the testing timeline
options.D: the inventor's biography, personal abilities and circle of acquaintances
options.E: the technical documentation, standards and safety requirements
